$comment: The director's panel catalogue. Fragments are prompt text, notes are UI subtitles. Camera and lens options describe the look of a medium rather than naming a manufacturer's product — Kinora ships its own identity, and a description steers a model better than a brand name does.

cameras.label: Large Format Digital
cameras.fragment: Captured on a large-format digital cinema sensor: clean highlight roll-off, wide latitude, and natural separation between the subject and the background.

cameras.label: Super 16 Film
cameras.fragment: Shot on Super 16 film: pronounced grain, gentle resolution falloff, warm midtones and slightly soft shadows.

cameras.label: 35mm Film
cameras.fragment: Shot on 35mm motion picture film: fine grain, rich latitude, halation blooming around the brightest highlights.

cameras.label: Video Camcorder
cameras.fragment: Recorded on a consumer video camcorder: interlaced softness, slight motion smear, crushed blacks and a dated broadcast look.

cameras.label: Full-Frame Digital
cameras.fragment: Captured on a full-frame mirrorless digital camera: neutral colour, high acuity, modern clean contrast.

lenses.label: Spherical Prime
lenses.fragment: Spherical prime lens: neutral geometry, round bokeh, no distortion at the edges.

lenses.label: Anamorphic
lenses.fragment: Anamorphic lens: oval bokeh, horizontal blue streak flares, and slight stretching towards the edges of a wide frame.

lenses.label: Vintage Uncoated
lenses.fragment: Vintage uncoated glass: low contrast, veiling flare across the frame, highlights that bloom and smear.

lenses.label: Macro
lenses.fragment: Macro lens: extreme close focus, a razor-thin plane of sharpness, the background dissolved completely.

lenses.label: Tilt-Shift
lenses.fragment: Tilt-shift lens: the plane of focus cuts across the frame at an angle, everything outside it falling away into a miniature blur.

lenses.label: Diffusion Filter
lenses.fragment: Heavy diffusion filtration: halation around every highlight, lifted blacks, a soft glow over the whole frame.

focalLengths.label: 14mm
focalLengths.fragment: 14mm ultra-wide: sweeping perspective, exaggerated depth, straight lines bending at the edges.

focalLengths.label: 24mm
focalLengths.fragment: 24mm wide: generous context around the subject with a mild perspective stretch.

focalLengths.label: 35mm
focalLengths.fragment: 35mm: natural reportage framing, close to how the eye reads a room.

focalLengths.label: 50mm
focalLengths.fragment: 50mm: neutral perspective, neither compressed nor stretched.

focalLengths.label: 85mm
focalLengths.fragment: 85mm: compressed background, the subject lifted forward, intimate framing.

apertures.label: f/1.4
apertures.fragment: Wide open at f/1.4: a paper-thin plane of focus, the background reduced to soft shapes and round highlights.

apertures.label: f/2.8
apertures.fragment: At f/2.8: shallow but controlled depth of field, the subject clean and the background legible but soft.

apertures.label: f/8
apertures.fragment: Stopped down to f/8: deep focus, foreground and background both sharp, everything in the frame readable.

genres.label: 1970s Neo-Noir
genres.fragment: 1970s neo-noir: sodium streetlight, rain on glass, a muted desaturated palette falling into deep shadow.

genres.label: 1970s Vérité
genres.fragment: 1970s vérité documentary: available light only, slightly underexposed, unglamorous and immediate.

genres.label: 1980s Sci-Fi
genres.fragment: 1980s science fiction: hard practical sources, atmospheric haze, cyan and magenta separation, visible beams cutting through smoke.

genres.label: 1990s Thriller
genres.fragment: 1990s thriller: a cool steel palette, hard contrast, clean geometric composition.

genres.label: Contemporary Drama
genres.fragment: Contemporary naturalistic drama: a soft neutral grade, motivated light only, restrained and observational.

genres.label: 1920s Silent Era
genres.fragment: 1920s silent era: orthochromatic black and white, heavy vignetting, high-key faces against dark surrounds, a visible flicker in the frame.

lighting.label: Single Practical
lighting.fragment: Lit by a single practical inside the frame — a lamp, a screen, a bulb — with steep falloff into darkness.

lighting.label: Hard Key + Rim
lighting.fragment: A hard key from one side with a bright rim from behind, carving the subject out of the background.

lighting.label: Soft Overcast
lighting.fragment: Soft overcast daylight: flat, shadowless, even across the whole frame.

lighting.label: Golden Hour
lighting.fragment: Low golden-hour sun raking across the frame, long shadows, warm highlights against cool shade.

lighting.label: Neon Night
lighting.fragment: Night, lit entirely by neon signage: saturated pools of colour, wet reflective surfaces, deep unlit gaps between them.

lighting.label: Firelight
lighting.fragment: Firelight as the only source: a warm flickering key from below, shadows moving across the walls.

motions.label: Dolly In
motions.fragment: The camera dollies steadily forward into the scene, the frame closing in without any change of lens.

motions.label: Dolly Out
motions.fragment: The camera dollies steadily backward, opening the frame and revealing more of the surroundings.

motions.label: Orbit
motions.fragment: The camera arcs smoothly around the subject on a level orbit, the background sliding past behind them.

motions.label: Crane Up
motions.fragment: The camera cranes upward and tilts down to hold the subject, rising above the scene.

motions.label: Crane Down
motions.fragment: The camera descends on a crane from above and settles at eye level on the subject.

motions.label: Handheld
motions.fragment: Handheld camera: small constant corrections, a breathing frame, the operator's weight visible in the movement.

motions.label: FPV Drone
motions.fragment: An FPV drone flies through the scene in one continuous take, banking through gaps and accelerating past obstacles.

motions.label: Whip Pan
motions.fragment: The camera whips sideways in a fast blurred pan and settles on the other side of the scene.

motions.label: Tracking Side
motions.fragment: The camera tracks sideways alongside the subject, holding them at a constant distance as the foreground streaks past.

motions.label: Static Lock-Off
motions.fragment: The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move; only what is inside the frame moves.
